candidates.label: Pectin
candidates.limitation: Apple pectin composition is provisional. Purified-pectin cultures can raise acetate and butyrate together, and the profile is often acetate-rich. That does not establish a butyrate-specific yield, epithelial exposure or tight-junction engagement.

foods.material: Apples, raw, with skin (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)

presence_records.label: Pectin
presence_records.notes: Soluble cell-wall polysaccharide; cultivar and extraction method vary.
presence_records.source_note: Liu et al. 2023 isolated pectin from 13 apple cultivars (peel, flesh and core) as alcohol-insoluble, water-soluble and chelating-soluble fractions. Yields and structure varied widely by cultivar. USDA SR Legacy (Apples, raw, with skin; FDC 171688) reports total fibre 2.4 g/100 g and does not quantify pectin. Extracted-fraction yields are not converted into a USDA-style per-100 g number for this record.

operation: Limit host exposure to bacterial endotoxin and related inflammatory microbial products.
